tasks.behavior: An invoice can list line items (description, quantity, unit price) that add up exactly to its amount, shown on the form, the invoice page and the PDF (PLAN 10.2)
acceptance: The create request takes optional lines (at most 50; description, quantity with up to 2 decimals, unit price in the amount's own unit); the lines must add up exactly to amount or amountUsd, else 422; they are part of the idempotency hash and never change
invoice_lines stores each line in the invoice's token base units; the database refuses a later insert, any update, and lines that do not sum to the invoice amount at commit

New invoice has Add item rows with a live total that becomes the amount; the owner's invoice page and the invoice PDF list the items with quantity, unit price and amount; axe 0 and no sideways scroll at 390 px
notes: 2026-10-17 review fail by reviewer: FAIL. (1) Wrong money on the form: apps/web/src/features/invoices/components/line-items.tsx:39 formats each line amount and the Total with formatTokenAmount default fractionDigits=2, which cuts digits. One token USDC, item Qty 1 x Price 12.345: the row and Total show 12.34 USDC, but the invoice is created for 12345000 (12.345 USDC) and the Preview shows 12.345; Qty 3 x 0.333333 shows 0.99 for 0.999999. Every other invoice money display uses exactDigits (invoice-lines.tsx, preview, detail). (2) DB guard gap vs acceptance 2: migration 00030 has no DELETE guard and the sum check fires only AFTER INSERT, so DELETE FROM invoice_lines WHERE invoice_id=X AND position=2 commits and leaves lines that no longer add up to the amount, against 'refuses lines that do not sum at commit' and 'never change' (api.md, architecture.md, migration comment). The two triggers also lack ENABLE ALWAYS, which every other invoice and ledger guard has, so session_replication_role=replica skips them. Nothing deletes invoices, so a BEFORE DELETE guard is safe. Minor, no fail on their own: (3) line-items.tsx:12,27,35 repeat 'description'|'quantity'|'price' and 'exact' instead of deriving from LINE_ERRORS (AGENTS.md TS rule). (4) Every row's fields share the labels 'Qty' and 'Price (X)'; only the description has the item number, so a screen reader user tabbing does not hear which item. (5) new-invoice-form.tsx:259-263: with items, a 422 mapped to amount/amountUsd sets an error on the hidden amount field; nothing shows. (6) document.go lines(): descriptions are cut to 3 lines in an 82 mm column, so a description over about 130 characters ends with an ellipsis on the PDF, though the API allows 200 (same as the title today). (7) USD lines also need the unit price itself in whole base units of the first option (create.go:127-133); R-88 and api.md state only the qty x price rule (amountUsd 0.000001, 2 x 0.0000005 gets 422). (8) Readers without items: pay page (public read returns lines, UI ignores them), emails, Preview, restart from a closed invoice (R-77 copies the amount, drops the items), lists/search/activity; fine for this acceptance. Checked and correct: Go exact-rational sum, per-line whole base units, USD lines scaled by the first option's decimals so the DB sum equals the main amount for multi-decimal payer-chooses, too-fine USD lines give 422 inside the tx (no 500, number rolled back), INSERT guard (main row, same tx), hash unchanged for requests without lines and 7.5==7.50, reads/JSON/openapi/api.md match, PDF and receipt use the main option's units in USD when the client chooses, invoice page uses the invoice's own option. Row shows 'Reference <PO>' above Due with the other quiet rows, only when invoice.reference is set (checked by hand: reference null gives no row); icon aria-hidden, same ICON/text-muted/gap as Due and Closes in; copy matches the PDF ('Reference <ref>'); R-90 row and DESIGN.md match. max-w-full on the ul is needed (items-start parent sizes it to the unbroken word) and works: a 100-char no-space reference wraps at 390 and 1440 px with no sideways scroll. pay.spec 19/19, vitest 87/87, lint, typecheck, docs-check pass. Clock fix is the right root cause: without page.clock the OPEN fixture (expiresAt 2026-10-17T15:00Z) reads as closed today (0 Show address buttons, 'This invoice is closed'); with NOW it is open, same as openPay. No other time bomb found: every other pay.spec test uses openPay or installs NOW, privy e2e fixtures are relative to Date.now() (fixed dates there are past, display only), unit tests pass now explicitly or use setSystemTime, kit date picker starts from a fixed value. Minor notes: (1) pay-invoice.tsx:284 items-center puts the icon beside the middle line when a long reference wraps, and the browser breaks after 'PO-'; items-start would keep it on line 1. (2) pay.spec.ts:701 only checks no sideways scroll, not that the full reference is visible, so a later truncate would still pass. (3) pay-invoice.tsx:282 comment mostly restates R-90. (4) pay.spec.ts:47 'as string | null' is unused.
